name: dev-engine core: embedded Vite + reverse proxy + header/cookie handling
description:
Start an embedded Vite server (middleware mode) compiling entry.js + CSS with real HMR. Reverse-proxy the target shop to http://127.0.0.1:PORT (plain HTTP, no TLS) via http-proxy-middleware, with responseInterceptor restricted to text/html only — everything else must stream through untouched (it buffers what it intercepts).

Implement host-header validation middleware (DNS-rebinding protection, adopted from Shopify's host-validation.ts).

Header/cookie handling, all adopted from the verified Shopify implementation: strip Content-Security-Policy from proxied responses, strip Upgrade-Insecure-Requests from outgoing requests, strip the Domain attribute from Set-Cookie, rewrite Location on redirects to the local origin, leave absolute URLs alone, and special-case cart/checkout/account routes (maintained allowlist with tests, not a one-off regex).

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §5.1.1.
